source.originalTagline: Your records can't disappear. Car maintenance log and reminders. No account, no server.

notes.caption6: Source read 'Every car in one glovebox.' - a pun on the retired brand name. After the rebrand to Wrenchy that reads as a stale product name in a six-word headline, so captions now say 'one place'. The long store descriptions still use the glove-compartment metaphor on purpose; there it is an image, not a name.
notes.lengths: Captions overlay a phone mockup, so each is held near the English source length. `maxLen` per locale is reported below - re-check line wrapping in Figma for de-DE, nl-NL and pl, which run longest.
notes.inspectionTerms: Captions deliberately avoid inspection names (MOT/TÜV/ITV/車検), which differ per market and are already carried by each locale's subtitle.
notes.apostrophe: Captions use the typographic apostrophe U+2019, matching the Figma source (“Your car’s”) and the live English screenshots. An ASCII "'" renders as a straight vertical tick in Cambay and reads as a typo at 128px.
